name: Jeff Ramaj
residence: Rock Springs, Sweetwater County (he wrote that he had lived there 40 years and was born in Indiana; 2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Small-business operator; he wrote that he established a trucking and construction company after Navy service and that he and his wife operate a small business founded in 1998 (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: Rock Springs High School, 1983 (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
military: U.S. Navy, marine diesel mechanic (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Jeff Ramaj wrote that he lived in Rock Springs, had lived there 40 years, was born in Indiana, and would be 59 on Election Day 2024. He wrote that he graduated from Rock Springs High School in 1983, enlisted in the U.S. Navy as a marine diesel mechanic, and after that service established a trucking and construction company. He said he and his wife operate a small business founded in 1998, and that he was raised as an Indiana farm boy.
